findings.friction_name: checkout dead-ends with a blank page after payment submit
findings.narrative: terminal_recovery_outcome is 'recovered-with-minor-detour', which the F161 fixed mapping assigns impact=1 — but severity_factors.impact is an unscoped ad-hoc value of 4, not traceable to the mapped category. This must fail the gate: an unconstrained numeric impact value defeats the whole point of giving impact a fixed rubric (F161 violation, CR4-B3).
